milestone_name: Newport Tile-Grid Foundational Map Production Gate
source_authorization: Chris June 2026 directive: square-grid source of truth for the entire Newport starting village, art-to-grid crosswalk, multi-square building footprints, cohesive harbor-town composition, itch.io-ready Godot web ZIP.

rationale: TileMapLayer + TileSet terrain autotiling natively implements the square-value architecture
Proven itch.io web packaging already exists (tools/package_itch_web.sh, G-21 hardening)
Free MIT license, no runtime fees
~495 merged PRs of validators, capture tooling, and atelier pipeline would be discarded by migration with no capability gain

north_star_guardrail: The starting village must read as a lively 1700s colonial Newport harbor town at the Tibia / Ragnarok Online craft bar, composed entirely from the authored tile grid with atelier-standard, provenance-traceable art.

core_architecture.avenue_width_squares: 10-15, reconciled with G-19R 360px target at NTG-0

chris_inputs_required.detail: Push or confirm parity for C:/Users/Chris/Documents/Wayfarer v2/Projects/wayfarer_newport against this GitHub repository before grid authoring begins.
Confirm or override recommended 64px square with character = 1 square footprint.

phases.title: Source Reconciliation + Grid Spec Lock
phases.purpose: Establish authoritative sources and lock the grid specification.

phases.title: Master Grid Authoring
phases.purpose: Assign every square of the Newport map a semantic value from the G-19R measured blockout.

phases.title: Art-to-Grid Crosswalk + Gap Analysis
phases.purpose: Map every atelier asset to tile IDs and multi-square footprints; queue missing art.

phases.title: Terrain TileMap Implementation
phases.purpose: Seamless ground composition in Godot generated from the master grid.

phases.title: Building Footprint Placement
phases.purpose: Place all buildings on grid lots with believable multi-square scale.

phases.title: Props + Street Furniture Layer
phases.purpose: Function-first harbor-town life props on prop-anchor squares.

phases.title: Walkability + NPC Route Validation
phases.purpose: Prove the town is traversable by players and NPCs from grid-derived collision.

phases.title: Cohesion + Atelier Visual QA
phases.purpose: Full-town review against the Newport Review Bar.

phases.title: itch.io Production Build Gate
phases.purpose: Ship the production web ZIP and stop for Chris review.
